data.name: Vanuatu
data.summary: Vanuatu levies no income tax on individuals or companies, no capital gains tax, no withholding tax and no estate or death duties (Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority). Revenue comes from 15% VAT, import duties, a 15% tax on rental income above VT 200,000 per six months and stamp duty of up to 1% on some property and share transfers. Vanuatu sells citizenship (from about USD 130,000, reported), but the EU suspended visa-free travel for Vanuatu passports over that programme.

regimes.name: Ordinary residence
regimes.description: No personal or corporate income tax, no capital gains, wealth or inheritance tax.
regimes.eligibility: No tax residence test is needed because there is no income tax; residence requires an immigration permit.

routes.name: Citizenship by investment (Development Support Program and related options)
routes.requirements: Reported government contribution about USD 130,000 for a single applicant plus about USD 25,000 for a spouse and further amounts per child, plus due diligence fees; no residence requirement (consultant guide, not verified against the Vanuatu Citizenship Commission). The EU partially suspended visa-free travel for Vanuatu passports issued since 25 May 2015 (Council decision March 2022), later reported as a full suspension; current status not verified. Citizenship alone gives no tax residence anywhere.

succession.name: Vanuatu
succession.summary: Vanuatu has a Wills Act and received UK trustee law, but custom land cannot be left by will. No fixed heirship share was found. Foundation law and Hague Trusts Convention status are not confirmed. A 2023 Law Reform Commission review of wills law is under way.
succession.family_claims: Not confirmed. The Law Reform Commission issued a 2023 issues paper on wills, probate and administration.
succession.foreign_law_note: No conflict-of-law rule was sourced. Custom land cannot pass by will (court decisions); intestacy uses UK-derived Succession, Probate and Administration Regulation 1972, per a government brochure.
succession.trust_note: UK Trustee law applies in part (administration of land by trustees). A Vanuatu trust statute was not found, so 'limited' is recorded. No foundation law found.

immigration.name: Vanuatu
immigration.summary: No free movement for anyone. The Development Support Program gives citizenship for USD 130,000 (single applicant) with no residence requirement, but the passport has no visa-free access to the EU (waiver suspended; reported as full from 2023 or December 2024) or the UK (visa required since 19 July 2023), and new acceptance is unconfirmed after 2025 programme pauses. Ordinary residence is by self-funded income of VUV 250,000 a month, a foreign investor certificate or employment.
immigration.naturalisation: Naturalisation requires 10 years of continuous lawful residence immediately before applying, good character, an official language and a citizenship test (Immigration Department and secondary summaries).
immigration.dual_citizenship_note: The Citizenship Act text requires naturalising applicants to renounce other citizenship, but a 2013 amendment is reported to allow dual citizenship (including for investors). Unresolved; check the current Act.

routes.name: Citizenship by Investment: Development Support Program (DSP)
routes.summary: A USD 130,000 non-returnable donation for a single applicant (USD 150,000 for a couple) gives Vanuatu citizenship without living there.
routes.requirements: Donation USD 130,000 single; USD 150,000 married couple; USD 165,000 couple plus one child; USD 180,000 couple plus two children; USD 10,000 per additional applicant. Due diligence (FIU) USD 5,000; application fee VUV 5,000. Legal basis: Citizenship Act CAP 112 s.13E and DSP Regulations, Order 33 of 2019. Agent and document costs extra (national ID and birth certificate rule from July 2025, reported). CBI citizens are reported permanently barred from voting. Status: the sister CIIP was paused in March 2025 and a review of the CIIP and DSP regulations was announced; a 2025 government-wide pause is reported with no confirmed reopening notice.
routes.investment_options: DSP only for new applicants; a Form D line of USD 260,000 (applicant, spouse and one child) also appears on the fees page.
routes.fees_note: Due diligence USD 5,000 plus VUV 5,000 application fee (not converted). Passport, certificate and agent fees extra.
routes.physical_presence: None. The aggregator lists a visit to Vanuatu as required with no duration; not confirmed.
routes.processing_time: Secondary sources vary from 30 to 90 days.
routes.tax_note: Vanuatu has no income tax, but citizenship does not end tax residence elsewhere. EU visa waiver suspended; UK visa required since 19 July 2023.

routes.name: Self-funded resident visa (retiree / passive income)
routes.summary: Residence for people living on certified monthly income paid into a Vanuatu bank.
routes.requirements: Certified monthly income from a Vanuatu bank of VUV 250,000 for a single applicant, VUV 500,000 including a spouse or de facto partner (VUV 3,000,000 a year single). A guide adds minimum age 55, proof of retired status and police clearances; not verified officially. Different criteria for pre-7 February 2011 retiree permit holders.
routes.fees_note: 'Applicable visa application charge in Vatu'; amount not stated.
routes.family: Spouse, unmarried children under 18, or 18-20 and dependent.
routes.tax_note: Vanuatu has no personal income tax; a permit does not end tax residence elsewhere.
